svg.text: Churn Prediction Service — Proposed Production Architecture
Feature engineering + model lifecycle, online scoring, platform auth, rate limiting, observability, and deployment evidence
Internal traffic uses existing service-mesh mTLS.
EKS Pod Identity; no static workload keys
Production: TLS termination + JWT validation at gateway/service
current: local script · prod: scheduled batch

text.tspan: baseline comparison · ROC-AUC / PR-AUC · threshold trade-offs
current take-home: manual/local gate before promotion
1,000 synthetic customers preserve observed event mix, timing,
session durations, purchase amounts, and recency shape.
Production retraining should use accumulated real histories.

svg.text: Terraform → S3, ECR, EKS, IAM, WAF, CloudWatch, SageMaker role · K8s manifests → service, ingress, OTel · Helm → AWS Load Balancer Controller
Solid components were applied/deployed in the interview AWS account. Dashed components are the existing-platform contract or production extension.
Cost-conscious sandbox: one small EKS node, one app replica, no always-on SageMaker inference endpoint.
